_comment: Administrare › Rapoarte (rpt-v1, 2026-11-09; Feature 96502 „Constructor de rapoarte”, child stories US-466…471 not in Azure yet). Seed of the report catalogue: global reports (Administrator central) + authority reports (one or more authorities), the formula set (Feature model «Formula») and the authorities a report can be assigned to. Data sources + their dictionary = the published sources of data/kpi.json (GEAPKpi.sources / fields, the Registre data dictionary). Column kinds: source (Din sursa de date) · calc (Calculată, formula + operands = report column ids). Data types: numeric · value (Valoric) · temporal · text. total: sum (Se adună în total) · incl (Inclusiv = a breakdown of the nearest «Se adună» column to its left). The preview values are demo values derived in js/rapoarte-admin.js. rpt-feature-v1 (2026-11-10): groupBy = ONE column id (Feature) — rpt-levels-v2: an ordered list of up to 3 column ids (PO proposal); filters = the PO's inline condition list (rpt-cond-restore-v1: { field, type } = an „Afișează filtru” condition, text → „conține”); Nivel is generated (Global = the Administrator central, optional authorities, none = all; Autoritate = the author's authority); a formula's `origin` = the report it was saved with (the set = the formulas of the reports the user can clone, on the same source).
